title: crataegus bosciana
intro: Crataegus bosciana, commonly known as Bosc's hawthorn, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include lowering blood pressure, improving cardiovascular health, and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Crataegus bosciana are attributed to its ability to dilate blood vessels, reduce cardiac workload, and act as an antioxidant. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic effects include flavonoids, such as quercetin, and oligomeric proanthocyanidins (OPCs), which contribute to its cardiovascular protective properties and antioxidant activity.
